customer.business: Good Car Club (GCC) - Stage 1: refurbished used alloy wheels, sold locally in north Kent
customer.target: Car owners in north Kent (Bexleyheath, Dartford, Medway) who want better-looking wheels or need a replacement wheel set without paying new prices
customer.where: Bexleyheath to Gillingham, north Kent; sold via Facebook Marketplace / eBay / Gumtree, collection from home

segments.name: Everyday driver replacing damaged or ugly wheels
Hobbyist or modifier who knows wheels

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Compares every Marketplace and eBay listing and haggles hard.

behaviours.name: Needs a fit guarantee
behaviours.how: Worried about PCD, offset and size; will ask to check the fit.

behaviours.name: Looks-driven
behaviours.how: Cares how the wheels look in photos; buys the nicest set.

behaviours.name: Reads seller profile
behaviours.how: Checks reviews and how long the seller has been on the platform.

behaviours.name: Wants tyres included
behaviours.how: Only interested if the tyres are good, to avoid extra cost.

behaviours.name: Knowledgeable hobbyist
behaviours.how: Knows brands and spots hidden damage like cracks or bends.

behaviours.name: Impulse buyer

objections: Will they actually fit my car?
Could they be cracked or bent?

Cheaper used sets on Marketplace and eBay
I do not want to travel to collect
habits: you scroll Facebook Marketplace most evenings
you drive your car to work every day
you have kerbed your wheels more than once

pitch:
Refurbished alloy wheels, set of four, 17 inch, in popular fitments (Ford, Vauxhall, VW, Audi, BMW, Mercedes sets stocked as available): £300 a set.
Cleaned, kerb damage repaired and refinished; each set checked for bends and cracks before sale.
Fit confirmed against your car's PCD, offset and size before you buy.
Seller: Good Car Club, Bexleyheath/Gillingham area. Collection from home, cash or bank transfer. New seller, no reviews yet.
7-day return if the wheels are returned undamaged and unmarked.
